reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset, and Brown read Paul's disclaimer of a direct command as ordinary apostolic inspiration, not an admission that the verse itself lacks inspiration.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Douglas Del Tondo catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Douglas Del Tondo, Jesus' Words Only (or Was Paul the Apostle Jesus Condemns in Revelation 2:2) (2006).
